DEVICE_LOCAL.persistence_lifecycle: Survives app updates, restarts, and sign-out. Never wiped upon logout.
entities: Recent searches and spatial filter chips
Offline media and transit timetable cache
DEVICE_LOCAL.account_scoping: ACCOUNT_AGNOSTIC (userId is NOT required or added as NOT NULL column in M16)

ACCOUNT_IDENTITY.persistence_lifecycle: Stored exclusively in Android Keystore / iOS Keychain; cleared immediately on sign-out or session revocation.

FUTURE_SYNCABLE.description: Backend has /api/v1/sync endpoints, but mobile sync is explicitly deferred to preserve device-primary integrity and avoid partial sync states.

NEVER_SYNC_BY_DEFAULT.rationale: Strict privacy and offline integrity guarantees
items: Raw GPS location coordinates or trajectory traces
